question: In a certain code the word 'BARK' is numerically coded as 5132 . The word 'BEND' is numerically coded as 5749 . How is the word 'BEARD' numerically coded in the same code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is : No specific pattern is followed here, random digits are assigned to each letter.

So,

 
• 'BARK' is numerically coded as 5132

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fdd73b770d0112b5e8a0afe9cca196f288060cb11fbde75b15f35f3f91e839f.png] 

And,

 
• 'BEND' is numerically coded as 5749

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93924706987821daeb9c948e35524545e221245679a1ee46ec682b9b3c513955.png] 

Thus, from the above it can be concluded as :

 
 

 **Letter**
 B
 A
 R
 K
 E
 N
 D
 
 

 **Code**
 5
 1
 3
 2
 7
 4
 9
 
 

​Similarly,

 
• 'BEARD' will be numerically coded as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f08370ff68413b9b6791519443a28bceeafb660702cc5df60dc8abe585b96dc2.png] 

​Hence, "**57139**" is the correct answer.
